titleEn: Training: from learning goals to skills

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as péixùn jìhuà. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added. Pairing: 制定培训计划. Watch-out: Rencana tidak cukup bila tanpa praktik.
words.when: Remember 培训计划 like the word you’ll use in HR/office talk for rencana pelatihan.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 培训计划 in this workplace sense. Book pairing: 制定培训计划. Watch-out: Rencana tidak cukup bila tanpa praktik.

example.zh: 我们先为新同事制定一个月的培训计划。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xiānwèi xīn tóngshì zhìdìng yígèyuè de péixùn jìhuà.
example.en: We will first make a one-month training plan for the new colleague.

words.when: Remember 学习目标 like the word you’ll use in HR/office talk for tujuan belajar.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 学习目标 in this workplace sense. Book pairing: 明确学习目标. Watch out: keep this workplace meaning, and do not swap it for a nearby word.

example.zh: 这次培训的学习目标是独立完成排班。
example.pinyin: Zhècì péixùn de xuéxí mùbiāo shì dúlì wánchéng páibān.
example.en: The goal of this training is to be able to build a work schedule on your own.

example.zh: 前两周由组长负责带教。
example.pinyin: Qián liǎngzhōu yóu zǔzhǎng fùzé dàijiào.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as shícāo. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added. Pairing: 实操练习. Watch-out: 实操 need tugas that jelas and umpan balik. kemampuan kerja / lanjutan
words.when: Remember 实操 like the word you’ll use in HR/office talk for praktik langsung.

example.zh: 讲完流程后，我们安排一次实操练习。
example.pinyin: Jiǎngwán liúchéng hòu, wǒmen ānpái yīcì shícāo liànxí.
example.en: After we explain the process, we will run a hands-on practice.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as ànlì. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added. Pairing: 分析案例. Watch out: keep this workplace meaning, and do not swap it for a nearby word.

words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 案例 in this workplace sense. Book pairing: 分析案例. Watch out: keep this workplace meaning, and do not swap it for a nearby word.

example.zh: 我们用一个匿名案例讨论沟通方式。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen yòng yígè nìmíng ànlì tǎolùn gōutōng fāngshì.
example.en: We will use one anonymous case to discuss how to communicate.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as liànxí. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added. Pairing: 做练习. Watch-out: 练习 not sama with hasil kerja langsung.
words.when: Remember 练习 like the word you’ll use in HR/office talk for latihan.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers use 练习 in this workplace sense. Book pairing: 做练习. Watch-out: 练习 not sama with hasil kerja langsung.

example.zh: 今天先做两轮电话沟通练习。
example.pinyin: Jīntiān xiān zuò liǎnglún diànhuà gōutōng liànxí.
example.en: Today lakukan dua putaran latihan komunikasi telepon.

words.note: Book headword pinyin printed as zhǎngwò. Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added. Pairing: 掌握流程. Watch out: keep this workplace meaning, and do not swap it for a nearby word.

example.zh: 完成实操后再判断是否掌握了流程。
example.pinyin: Wánchéng shícāo hòu zài pànduàn shìfǒu zhǎngwò le liúchéng.
example.en: after praktik, baru nilai alurnya already dikuasai.

example.zh: 培训结束后会有一次简短评估。
example.pinyin: Péixùn jiéshù hòuhuì yǒu yīcì jiǎnduǎn pínggū.
example.en: after training will ada evaluasi singkat.

example.zh: 这次培训主要帮助团队提升沟通效率。
example.pinyin: Zhècì péixùn zhǔyào bāngzhù tuánduì tíshēng gōutōng xiàolǜ.
example.en: Pelatihan ini terutama membantu tim meningkatkan efisiensi komunikasi.

example.zh: 新同事需要一点时间适应团队节奏。
example.pinyin: Xīn tóngshì xūyào yìdiǎn shíjiān shìyìng tuánduì jiézòu.
example.en: colleague baru butuh waktu for menyesuaikan diri with ritme team.

notes.title: Latihan 90 detik
notes.body: If this HR module prints a 90-second drill, pick three headwords from the module, build one work story, record without reading, and check timing and decisions.
